name: @sos-2/self-evolution-harness
description: SOS 2.0 Self-Evolution Harness (Work Order W16): a runnable end-to-end harness over the golden self-evolution scenario (SOS-process fixtures: the W15 golden object system + the golden meta-strategy state) executing BOTH paths deterministically — the HEALTHY path (a governance-preserving MetaChange measured, decisioned, promoted, revision applied) and the ADVERSARIAL path (a governance-weakening proposal rejected by the non-disableable guard; a failed/effectiveness-negative change rolled back AND retained in liability memory), plus the first-class ASK path. Zero domain logic: everything is imported from @sos-2/meta-evolution. Prints the deterministic summary (proposals -> guard verdicts -> measurements -> decisions -> retained failures -> process revision) and exits 0 ONLY if every stage succeeded and the trace chain is complete. No network, no time dependence (single caller-supplied instant, fixed seed).
